preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= N <= 10**5 for N in N_values)

preconditions.description: The sum of all N values across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i], str) for i in range(T))
all(output[i] == '-1' or len(output[i].split()) == N_values[i] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output is either '-1' or contains N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output[i].split()[j]) in range(1, N_values[i]+1) for i in range(T) for j in range(N_values[i]))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(output[i].split())) == N_values[i] for i in range(T) if output[i] != '-1')
postconditions.description: Each output contains unique integers if it is not '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output[i].split()[j]) ^ int(output[i].split()[j+1]) != int(output[i].split()[j+2]) for i in range(T) for j in range(N_values[i]-2) if output[i] != '-1')
postconditions.description: For each valid output, the XOR condition is satisfied.
